verdict.rationale: Baseten documents public APIs for inference: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages endpoints, async inference with webhook or polling, and usage queries by API key. Its Loops training also runs each step as an API call. Deployment and workspace management are documented mainly through the CLI (`truss push`, `baseten model push`) and an MCP server/skill rather than a documented management REST API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented public management API for deployments and workspace operations, a published OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Call hosted models through an OpenAI-compatible API, deploy your own models on dedicated infrastructure
They support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and the Anthropic Messages API in beta, so you can use familiar client SDKs.
Async inference returns a request ID quickly and completes later through webhook or polling
You can also set a workspace budget and query usage by API key or model.
Loops provisions a dedicated trainer and paired sampler, and each training step is an API call from a Python loop you write.
